stories.title: Regeni, egiziani condannati, dieci anni per il sequestro. “Giulio rapito dal regime”

en.title: Regeni, Egyptians convicted, ten years for abduction. "Giulio kidnapped by regime"
en.summary: Three Egyptian military officers were convicted of kidnapping Giulio Regeni, with murder charges not upheld. A fourth intelligence officer was acquitted.

stories.title: “Chiedevamo la verità abbiamo ottenuto giustizia”. L’emozione dei genitori di Giulio Regeni

en.title: "We sought truth and obtained justice". The emotion of Giulio Regeni's parents
en.summary: Giulio Regeni's parents expressed satisfaction with the verdict and called on the government to follow through on the court's decision.

stories.title: Ustica, svolta dopo 46 anni. Parigi pronta a collaborare, l’indagine non sarà archiviata

en.title: Ustica, breakthrough after 46 years. Paris ready to cooperate, investigation will not be closed
en.summary: France announced willingness to transfer documents related to the Ustica case, potentially advancing the investigation into the 1980 incident.

stories.title: Morte di Regeni al Cairo, dieci anni per sequestro a tre 007 egiziani. Ma cade l'accusa di omicidio

en.title: Death of Regeni in Cairo, ten years for abduction to three Egyptian intelligence officers. But murder charge dropped
en.summary: A Rome court convicted three Egyptian officers of kidnapping Regeni with murder charges dismissed, while acquitting a fourth agent. Regeni's parents called for government action.

stories.title: Turchia-Italia, le pagelle degli azzurri: Kayode straripante, Pio Esposito decisivo

en.title: Turkey-Italy, player ratings for the Azzurri: Kayode outstanding, Pio Esposito decisive
en.summary: Italian players received ratings following their match against Turkey in Bursa, with Kayode and Pio Esposito highlighted for strong performances.

stories.title: Raid russi sul centro di Kiev, colpiti il ministero dell’Istruzione e l’Accademia delle scienze

en.title: Russian raids on Kiev city center, Education Ministry and Academy of Sciences hit
en.summary: Strong explosions occurred overnight in Ukraine's capital, with air defense systems responding to Russian attacks on government and scientific institutions.

en.title: Nations League: Turkey-Italy 1-4
en.summary: Italy defeated Turkey 4-1 in a Nations League match, with Bastoni scoring first and Pio Esposito scoring the final goal.

stories.title: Nations League. Pio Esposito cala il poker azzurro: Turchia-Italia 1-4

en.title: Nations League. Pio Esposito scores the fourth goal for Italy: Turkey-Italy 1-4
en.summary: Pio Esposito completed Italy's 4-1 victory over Turkey in the Nations League after the Turkish goalkeeper made an error, allowing the Inter striker to score the final goal.

stories.title: Nations League. Michael Kayode in gol al debutto con la maglia azzurra: Turchia-Italia 0-3

en.title: Nations League. Michael Kayode scores on debut with the Italian national team: Turkey-Italy 0-3
en.summary: Michael Kayode of Brentford marked his Italy debut with a goal in their Nations League match against Turkey, validating coach Roberto Mancini's selection choice.

stories.title: La lettura della sentenza per l'omicidio di Giulio Regeni, tre 007 egiziani condannati a 10 anni

en.title: Verdict in Giulio Regeni murder case, three Egyptian intelligence officers sentenced to 10 years
en.summary: Rome's Assise Court delivered three convictions for kidnapping in connection with Giulio Regeni's death and acquitted Tareq Sabyr. The defendants were absent during the verdict announcement.

stories.title: L'omicidio Regeni, 10 anni di depistaggi e impunità

en.title: The Regeni murder, 10 years of cover-ups and impunity
en.summary: Giulio Regeni disappeared in Cairo on January 25, 2016 and was later found bearing signs of severe torture. Egyptian authorities have maintained silence and engaged in obstruction regarding the case.

stories.title: La morte di Giulio Regeni: 007 egiziani condannati per il sequestro ma non per l'omicidio

en.title: Giulio Regeni's death: Egyptian intelligence officers convicted for kidnapping but not murder
en.summary: Nearly 3,890 days after the student's body was discovered on February 3, 2016 in Cairo, a verdict was reached. The 28-year-old researcher had been kidnapped on January 25, 2016.

stories.title: Centrali nucleari, siglato a Parigi il sodalizio tra l’italiana Caen e la Cea francese

en.title: Nuclear power plants, partnership between Italian Caen and French CEA signed in Paris
en.summary: An Italian-French joint venture called Caen Solutions Nucléaires was established in Paris, combining an Italian company specializing in artificial intelligence measurement technology with a French public entity.

stories.title: Le imprese ritrovano la crescita. Investimenti record nel 2025

en.title: Businesses find growth again. Record investments in 2025
en.summary: A Mediobanca survey of 1,700 companies with over 500 employees shows revenues increased 39.6% over a decade, with a 0.5% recovery last year following two years of decline.

stories.title: Milano, una nuova partecipata dedicata all’housing sociale

en.title: Milan, a new municipal company dedicated to social housing
en.summary: Milan has established a new municipal company focused on developing rental housing at controlled prices for middle-income residents.

en.title: Work-life balance certification launches
en.summary: Certifying bodies authorized to issue work-life balance attestations to companies are being announced today. Companies can receive tax relief of up to 50,000 euros annually for family-friendly workplace policies.

stories.title: Scatto dell’export extra-Ue, con Svizzera, Cina e Usa

en.title: Surge in exports outside EU, with Switzerland, China and USA
en.summary: Italian exports to non-EU countries grew 16.1 percent year-over-year in August, driven notably by increased shipments to Switzerland, China, and the United States.
